verdict.spinor_status: OPEN -- neither earned nor killed by this tournament run
retained_frontier: lane3_projective_ray: highest raw occluded-bit accuracy (0.6318) at moderate cost (18312 params), but the strength is shallow -- shuffled-object-id control (0.5921) captures most of the margin, and Holevo/ARI/P6 are all honest negatives. Retained as the strongest similarity-only comparator, not as an object-binding result.

lane5_multivector: best Holevo margin among the non-spinor/engineering-control lanes (+0.0277 over p95) with a real (if self-gate-failing) ARI signal, but P9 shows essentially zero attractor contraction (0.0005) and the lane openly documents a config trade-off (an alt config hit 0.635 occluded acc with zero identity structure) it chose not to collapse. Card classifies this as an engineering control, not spinor semantics -- kept in the frontier on that basis, not as a spinor result.

lane6_spinor_ideal: best all-around probe balance -- only lane combining a real P1 coherent-path interference witness, a positive P6 counterfactual-binding gap, and simultaneous above-null Holevo+ARI -- at the cheapest budget among structurally-charged lanes (3232 params). Retained as the strongest spinor-semantics candidate, with the explicit caveat that its margins are thin and it lacks the P5 shuffled-id control the other lanes report.

lane7_purified_density: richest charge set and the tournament's only formally proved (z3 UNSAT) order witness, at the lowest param count of any lane (880), but self-reports all_pass:false with a decorative-dynamics honest negative on P6 and an ARI that sits below its own null. Retained as a genuine spinor-semantics attempt with named, unsmoothed failures -- not as a winner.
killed_with_witnesses: lane4_quaternion, on P6 specifically: learned typed rotor transport is ray-WORSE than the identity counterfactual (0.3375 < 0.5) -- the action is demonstrably not bound to the dynamics in this run. This is the tournament's clearest single-probe kill, on an AMENDMENT-primary probe, on the exact carrier the falsifier names as the spinor-killing candidate. Recorded as a lane-level failure on P6, not a full-lane kill (lane4 does clear budget and shows a real, if task-decoupled, P1 lift-capacity witness).
not_killed: lane1_vector_scout (intended control floor -- behaves as designed, not a research kill)
lane2_vector_jepa (weak but not disqualified; honest negatives on Holevo/P1, no positive claim made or needed since it is the classical comparator)

findings: All 7 lanes comply with the 16-DOF / 60k-param / 300-step budget; no disqualifications on that rule.
lane4 (quaternion) carries a self-recorded memory-gate breach (23.8% free vs 25% required threshold, proceeded anyway) -- a protocol flag, not a budget disqualification.
lane7 (purified density) self-reports all_pass:false on its own gates (G_occ_acc, G_ari); kept as an honest negative, not smoothed by this scorer.
lane6 (spinor ideal) is missing the occluded-accuracy shuffled-object-id control every other tested lane reports; its P5 strength is comparatively under-controlled.
Frozen falsifier NOT triggered: neither lane2 (vector) nor lane4 (quaternion) passes all P1-P10 -- both have genuine honest-negative failures on primary probes.
Spinor-winner clause NOT triggered either: neither lane6 nor lane7 wins across ALL probes -- lane6's margins are thin and under-controlled, lane7 self-fails two of its own gates.

Verdict: spinor_status OPEN. Frontier retained across lane3, lane5, lane6, lane7 -- incomparable strengths, not collapsed to a single winner. lane4's P6 result is the tournament's clearest single-probe kill witness, on the exact probe and carrier the card's falsifier names.
